## Documented role

The [IFRC “Our Team” page](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd) (inspected) states that Paul Gauthier is founder and executive director of the Individualized Funding Resource Centre Society and “one of the founders of the Choice in Supports for Independent Living (CSIL) program.” The same page’s Anthony Cheng biography says Gauthier “started on the CSIL program in 1994.” Those are IFRC statements, not inspected 1990s ministry records.

None recorded from a named oral-history protocol.
